stats.notes: Budget is nearly exhausted, so I'm stopping here. One confirmed bug: stepping onto spikes while the score is below 500 wraps the score around to about 65,000 instead of clamping at 0. Reproduced in runs 2 and 4 (seed 1). The only route to spikes (3,3) passes the coin at (1,3), so the 4-token sequence is the minimal repro. Unverified suspicion: a dash-down from (2,1) may pass through the wall at (2,2). It is not reported because I did not confirm it.
